versions.generator_version: Changes only when identical seed + parameters would generate a different map.
versions.rules_version: Changes when authoritative action or combat rules change.

transport.optional_dynamic_relay: HTTP GET/POST is supported by PayloadBridge only when a real dynamic endpoint is configured. A static host cannot receive POST requests.

determinism: Map generation, weapon scattering, AI scoring jitter, combat evasion, and salvage rolls derive from the explicit mission seed. Narrative wording uses a separate derived stream.
